events.comment:
================================================================================
SYSTEM: ECONOMY SYSTEM (SPRINT 3.4.5 — GOLD TRANSACTION & WALLET DECOUPLING)
AUTHOR: Antigravity | LAST MODIFIED: 2026-07-16
PURPOSE: Quản lý toàn bộ giao dịch Gold (Wallet). Cấm tuyệt đối hệ thống khác gán
gold += 50. Lắng nghe EconomyAddGoldRequest và FlowerHarvested. Phát EconomyGoldUpdated.
================================================================================
BLOCK 1: GOLD ADDITION TRANSACTION (e.g., FlowerHarvested / Quest Reward)

actions.comment: If FlowerHarvested, add gold_earned from payload. If EconomyAddGoldRequest, add requested gold -> Emit EconomyGoldUpdated & MarkSaveDirty

events.comment: BLOCK 2: GOLD DEDUCTION TRANSACTION (e.g., Shop Purchase)

actions.comment: Check balance >= requested deduction -> Deduct -> Emit EconomyGoldUpdated & MarkSaveDirty
